Thijssseweg 11 2629 JA Delft The Netherlands T +31 88 6362332 certin@nmi.nl www.nmi.nl This document is issued under the provision that no liability is accepted and that the applicant shall indemnify third-party liability. The notification of NMi Certin B.V. as Issuing Authority can be verified at www.oiml.org This document is digitally signed and sealed. Ratio of minimum LC Verification interval (1)
Y = Emax / vmin		11900

Z = Emax / (2 * DR)		5000

Humidity ClassCH
Safe overload200 % of Emax
